question: What is the ANTONYM of the word ‘accurate’, " as used in the passage?
solution:
The correct answer is Option 2 i.e.** "Inexact".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Accurate**: (सटीक) - Free from errors or mistakes; exact and correct.

 
 
• **Example**: The GPS provides accurate directions.
 
 
 
• **Inexact**: (असटीक) - Not completely accurate or precise.
 
 
• **Example**: His recollection of the event was inexact and vague.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Inexact"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Correct**: (सही) - Free from error; in accordance with fact or truth.

 
 
• **Example**: Her answer to the question was correct.
 
 
 
• **Precise**: (शुद्ध) - Marked by exactness and accuracy of expression or detail.
 
 
• **Example**: The architect demanded precise measurements for the blueprint.
 
 
 
• **Reliable**: (विश्वसनीय) - Consistently good in quality or performance; able to be trusted.
 
 
• **Example**: She is reliable and always completes her work on time.
